title: Model router with Groq/Gemini providers, local and template fallback
scope: Implement get_model("reasoning" | "fast" | "document") per ADR-031: mock provider as default, Groq GPT-OSS 120B/20B and Gemini Flash adapters behind the existing model ports, optional local open-weights model (e.g. Ollama), and the deterministic template as the last fallback; mapping and keys only from the ignored .env; record provider, model id, role, prompt version, settings, fallback level, latency and tokens on every output

acceptance.text: Agents obtain models only via get_model(role); no graph imports a provider SDK or reads a key; with no keys the mock provider is used and agent_eval --check, smoke and tests pass offline; new packages are pinned in ai/requirements.lock

Per call fallback hosted -> local -> template on 429, timeout, refusal, invalid structured output or failed validation, each case unit-tested; every output records provider, model id, role, prompt version, settings, fallback level, latency and token use

Opt-in live smoke (skipped without keys) runs each configured role once against synthetic data and records observed model ids, account rate limits, latency and tokens; the Gemini document model id is confirmed by the team or the role is left unconfigured as recorded in ADR-031
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Opt-in live smoke (skipped without keys) runs each configured role once against synthetic data and records observed model ids, account rate limits, latency and tokens; the Gemini document model id is confirmed by the team or the role is left unconfigured as recorded in ADR-031

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 after a runtime gap analysis for the RSL demo: the component code existed but this link was not wired at runtime and no task covered it.

Rescoped 2026-11-05 per ADR-031: the agreed plan uses Groq/Gemini free tiers as primary for synthetic data; the local model is a fallback, not the only path. Dependency on TAX-088 removed (the router does not need live cases; TAX-088 now depends on this).
Keletso approved ADR-031 on 2026-11-05 and confirmed gemini-3.6-flash as the document model; verify its context window and observed free-tier limits before relying on it.
